query: How do I remov a TechDocs addon from my Red Hat Developer Hub instance if I used a Helm chart for the installashun?
response:
To remove a TechDocs add-on from a Red Hat Developer Hub instance installed with the **Helm chart**, edit your Helm `values.yaml` and remove the add-on from the `techdocsAddons` list, then run `helm upgrade`.

## 1. Edit your Helm values

Find the dynamic plugin configuration for the TechDocs add-ons package:

```yaml
global:
  dynamic:
    plugins:
      - package: ./dynamic-plugins/dist/backstage-plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib
        disabled: false
        pluginConfig:
          dynamicPlugins:
            frontend:
              backstage.plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib:
                techdocsAddons:
                  - importName: ReportIssue
                  - importName: TextSize
```

Remove the add-on you no longer want. For example, to remove `TextSize`:

```yaml
global:
  dynamic:
    plugins:
      - package: ./dynamic-plugins/dist/backstage-plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib
        disabled: false
        pluginConfig:
          dynamicPlugins:
            frontend:
              backstage.plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib:
                techdocsAddons:
                  - importName: ReportIssue
```

Red Hat’s docs describe this as deleting the relevant `importName: <external_techdocs_add-on>` entry from the `techdocsAddons` section of the Helm chart. Source: [TechDocs for Red Hat Developer Hub](https://docs.redhat.com/en/documentation/red_hat_developer_hub/1.10/html-single/techdocs_for_red_hat_developer_hub/index).

## 2. Apply the change with Helm

Run a Helm upgrade using your updated values file:

```bash
helm upgrade <release-name> redhat-developer-hub \
  --repo https://charts.openshift.io \
  --namespace <namespace> \
  -f values.yaml
```

If you installed with a specific chart version, include it:

```bash
helm upgrade <release-name> redhat-developer-hub \
  --repo https://charts.openshift.io \
  --namespace <namespace> \
  --version <chart-version> \
  -f values.yaml
```

## 3. Optional: disable the whole add-ons plugin package

If you want to temporarily disable **all** TechDocs add-ons from that plugin package, set `disabled: true` instead:

```yaml
global:
  dynamic:
    plugins:
      - package: ./dynamic-plugins/dist/backstage-plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib
        disabled: true
```

Be aware that this disables every add-on loaded from that package, not just one add-on.

## 4. Verify

After the upgrade:

```bash
kubectl get pods -n <namespace>
```

Wait for the RHDH pod to restart successfully, then open Developer Hub and check TechDocs. The removed add-on should no longer appear or function.

query: How do I remov a TechDocs addon from my Red Hat Developer Hub instance if I used a Helm chart for the installashun?
response:
To remove a TechDocs add-on from a Red Hat Developer Hub instance installed with the **Helm chart**, edit your Helm `values.yaml` and remove the add-on from the `techdocsAddons` list, then run `helm upgrade`.

## 1. Edit your Helm values

Find the dynamic plugin configuration for the TechDocs add-ons package:

```yaml
global:
  dynamic:
    plugins:
      - package: ./dynamic-plugins/dist/backstage-plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib
        disabled: false
        pluginConfig:
          dynamicPlugins:
            frontend:
              backstage.plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib:
                techdocsAddons:
                  - importName: ReportIssue
                  - importName: TextSize
```

Remove the add-on you no longer want. For example, to remove `TextSize`:

```yaml
global:
  dynamic:
    plugins:
      - package: ./dynamic-plugins/dist/backstage-plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib
        disabled: false
        pluginConfig:
          dynamicPlugins:
            frontend:
              backstage.plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib:
                techdocsAddons:
                  - importName: ReportIssue
```

Red Hat’s docs describe this as deleting the relevant `importName: <external_techdocs_add-on>` entry from the `techdocsAddons` section of the Helm chart. Source: [TechDocs for Red Hat Developer Hub](https://docs.redhat.com/en/documentation/red_hat_developer_hub/1.10/html-single/techdocs_for_red_hat_developer_hub/index).

## 2. Apply the change with Helm

Run a Helm upgrade using your updated values file:

```bash
helm upgrade <release-name> redhat-developer-hub \
  --repo https://charts.openshift.io \
  --namespace <namespace> \
  -f values.yaml
```

If you installed with a specific chart version, include it:

```bash
helm upgrade <release-name> redhat-developer-hub \
  --repo https://charts.openshift.io \
  --namespace <namespace> \
  --version <chart-version> \
  -f values.yaml
```

## 3. Optional: disable the whole add-ons plugin package

If you want to temporarily disable **all** TechDocs add-ons from that plugin package, set `disabled: true` instead:

```yaml
global:
  dynamic:
    plugins:
      - package: ./dynamic-plugins/dist/backstage-plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib
        disabled: true
```

Be aware that this disables every add-on loaded from that package, not just one add-on.

## 4. Verify

After the upgrade:

```bash
kubectl get pods -n <namespace>
```

Wait for the RHDH pod to restart successfully, then open Developer Hub and check TechDocs. The removed add-on should no longer appear or function.

response:
To remove a TechDocs add-on from a Red Hat Developer Hub instance installed with the **Helm chart**, edit your Helm `values.yaml` and remove the add-on from the `techdocsAddons` list, then run `helm upgrade`.

## 1. Edit your Helm values

Find the dynamic plugin configuration for the TechDocs add-ons package:

```yaml
global:
  dynamic:
    plugins:
      - package: ./dynamic-plugins/dist/backstage-plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib
        disabled: false
        pluginConfig:
          dynamicPlugins:
            frontend:
              backstage.plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib:
                techdocsAddons:
                  - importName: ReportIssue
                  - importName: TextSize
```

Remove the add-on you no longer want. For example, to remove `TextSize`:

```yaml
global:
  dynamic:
    plugins:
      - package: ./dynamic-plugins/dist/backstage-plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib
        disabled: false
        pluginConfig:
          dynamicPlugins:
            frontend:
              backstage.plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib:
                techdocsAddons:
                  - importName: ReportIssue
```

Red Hat’s docs describe this as deleting the relevant `importName: <external_techdocs_add-on>` entry from the `techdocsAddons` section of the Helm chart. Source: [TechDocs for Red Hat Developer Hub](https://docs.redhat.com/en/documentation/red_hat_developer_hub/1.10/html-single/techdocs_for_red_hat_developer_hub/index).

## 2. Apply the change with Helm

Run a Helm upgrade using your updated values file:

```bash
helm upgrade <release-name> redhat-developer-hub \
  --repo https://charts.openshift.io \
  --namespace <namespace> \
  -f values.yaml
```

If you installed with a specific chart version, include it:

```bash
helm upgrade <release-name> redhat-developer-hub \
  --repo https://charts.openshift.io \
  --namespace <namespace> \
  --version <chart-version> \
  -f values.yaml
```

## 3. Optional: disable the whole add-ons plugin package

If you want to temporarily disable **all** TechDocs add-ons from that plugin package, set `disabled: true` instead:

```yaml
global:
  dynamic:
    plugins:
      - package: ./dynamic-plugins/dist/backstage-plugin-techdocs-module-addons-contrib
        disabled: true
```

Be aware that this disables every add-on loaded from that package, not just one add-on.

## 4. Verify

After the upgrade:

```bash
kubectl get pods -n <namespace>
```

Wait for the RHDH pod to restart successfully, then open Developer Hub and check TechDocs. The removed add-on should no longer appear or function.
